caption: The drawing depicts a single object: a decorative cast iron figure in the shape of a man dressed in historical clothing, possibly from the 18th or 19th century. The figure is standing in a forward stride, with one leg bent and the other extended behind, and both hands placed on its hips. The figure wears boots, breeches, a long coat with buttons, and a decorated vest. The head is topped with a tall, ornate hat that has a plume or feather detail. The colors used in the drawing are mostly earth tones, with rusty browns, oranges, subtle greens, and muted golds giving the impression of aged or weathered metal painted in certain areas. Attached to the figure at the waist is a horizontal rectangular bar extending backward, which is rendered in brown and connects to a vertical support, suggesting the function of a doorstop or andiron. The background is plain and neutral, keeping the focus entirely on the object.
title: Andiron
